On January 23, 2025, Donald Trump signed Executive Order 14179, titled "Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence." This executive order aims to strengthen U.S. leadership in AI, promote AI development without ideological bias or social agendas, establish an action plan for maintaining global AI dominance, and revise or rescind conflicting policies.

FINAL: Executive Order 14179, signed on January 23, 2025, aimed at strengthening U.S. leadership in AI.
